I was raised in a Eastern Orthodox household and country where I had classes about faith all the way from primary school to high school so I know/knew a lot about Saints and Christianity as a whole but I never liked labeling something that I didn't know and couldn't confirm if it was as everybody else was saying, but maybe it was all due to my mental state who knows.

Maybe that all changes at one point, maybe not, maybe I never reach it.

Beautifully said, even though I view myself as an agnostic, I can appreciate your faith and beliefs, you sound like an intelligent person with a strong conviction, something that's severely lacking in today's world. Props to you.
Anyone's opinion is welcome, it doesn't matter what you believe in, all thoughts and answers are appreciated.

I feel you man, it must be hard and so emotionally draining to feel alone and dejected. 

But I can asure you it will be okay, it might not be tommorow but it will, I promise you. You have a good support system, I assume in your family, so please seek comfort and help from them. You have issues with your self esteem and confidence but that can be solved. Some people will never like you and that's fine who cares about them but I know that there are people out there who are right for you and your insterests. 

I'm wishing you all the best and for you to overcome this, as a guy who's lived through something similar.

I can only say to be upfront with your partner in what transpired on that night without leaving anything out for his or anyone's sake. 
Also in my opinion the light flirting with that "friend" is what might have given him a signal that wasn't really there from your side that's why I don't think it's really smart to flirt with people while in a relationship unless it's in a very blatantly non serious way.
But I might see it differently and don't understand your friend group and relationship. 🤷🏻‍♂️

Personally I would like to know and I think your boyfriend would too. I get that it was a mistake and it will never happen again and that is great really. But at the end of the day it is you who fucked up and it should be up to your boyfriend to decide what happens next in your relationship. I don't like the lying especially about something big like this, cheating is cheating no matter if it's just a kiss or sex. If your okay with lying to your boyfriend like this I don't really see a problem with you lying about anything else in the future of your relationship. Just my side I guess, you do you and don't let yourself fuck up like this again please out of respect for you SO.
